research.notes:
**ORCL news, 2026-09-29 to 2026-10-29**

**1. Guidance**
- Oracle reaffirmed FY27 guidance of at least $90B revenue and non-GAAP EPS of $8.10. It also set FY30 targets of $225B+ revenue (more than 35% CAGR), 40%+ non-GAAP operating margin and $21+ EPS. — 2026-10-28 — https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/oracle-investor-day-2026-accelerating-value-creation-302922564.html
- Free cash flow is guided to turn positive in the second half of FY28 and reach $30B+ in FY29. Capex peaks in FY27–28. Additional capital raises through FY30 are capped at $20B ($10B equity, $10B gross debt), on top of the $20B ATM equity program completed in Q1. — 2026-10-28 — https://www.stocktitan.net/sec-filings/ORCL/8-k-oracle-corp-reports-material-event-904a3640ad1c.html
- Versus expectations, sources differ. GuruFocus says the guide was slightly below consensus of $8.14 EPS and $90.45B revenue (https://www.gurufocus.com/news/9148266/oracle-orcl-shares-surge-over-9-following-fiscal-2027-outlook-confirmation). A second GuruFocus piece says it was in line with about $90.43B (https://www.gurufocus.com/news/9148263/oracle-orcl-confirms-fy-2027-revenue-target-of-90-billion-at-investor-day-2026). — 2026-10-28
- The stock rose on the news. Closing gains differ by source: +10.73% to $144.54 (https://www.fool.com/coverage/stock-market-today/2026/10/28/stock-market-today-oct-28-oracle-surges-on-fiscal-2030-revenue-guidance-of-usd225-billion/) and +12.09% (https://www.tradingkey.com/news/market-movers/262247707-market-movers-orcl-20261028). — 2026-10-28
- No pre-announcement or guidance cut found in the window. The last earnings report (Q1 FY27) was 2026-09-10, before the window: https://investor.oracle.com/investor-news/news-details/2026/Oracle-Announces-Q1-Results-Driven-by-Triple-Digit-Growth-in-Cloud-Infrastructure-Revenues/default.aspx

**2. Analyst actions**
- Goldman Sachs (Kash Rangan) kept Buy and cut its price target from $240 to $206. — 2026-10-23 — https://www.benzinga.com/quote/ORCL/price-targets
- Cantor Fitzgerald (Thomas Blakey) kept Overweight with a $284 target. Benzinga dates this 2026-10-22 (same URL as above). TipRanks dates it 2026-10-21, and also shows RBC at Hold with a $165 target, reiterated 2026-10-21. — https://www.tipranks.com/stocks/orcl/forecast
- Mizuho (Siti Panigrahi) reiterated Outperform with a $320 target. — 2026-10-14 — https://finbold.com/wall-street-analyst-updates-oracle-stock-price-target/
- Yorkville Ives initiated coverage at Hold with a $155 target. — 2026-10-07 — https://www.investing.com/equities/oracle-corp-consensus-estimates
- Citizens (Patrick Walravens) reiterated Market Outperform with a $285 target. — 2026-10-02 — https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/ORCL/analyst-insights/
- A GuruFocus item reports Piper Sandler holding Overweight with a $225 target. It is dated 2026-10-30, which is after today's date, so treat it as unverified. — https://www.gurufocus.com/news/9150297/orcl-maintained-by-piper-sandler-price-target-stays-at-225
- I found no upgrades or downgrades in the window.

**3. Litigation and regulation**
- A securities class action is pending in the District of Delaware. It alleges false statements about the cloud infrastructure business and names Oracle's CTO, one CEO, two other executives and one director. The amended complaint was filed 2026-07-14. A motion to dismiss, if filed, is to be fully briefed by 2026-12-18. — 2026-07-14 — https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001341439/000119312526389274/orcl-20260831.htm
- Three former employees sued in Alameda County Superior Court. They allege layoffs were timed to avoid RSU vesting. — 2026-10-07 — https://www.rwcpulse.com/news/2026/10/23/lawsuit-ex-employees-claim-oracle-layoffs-cheated-them-of-1-million-in-company-stock/
- A Texas AG filing reportedly shows an Oracle Health breach affecting 19,929,149 people, including 2,992,244 Texans. This is from a lower-tier source, and the filing date is only given as Oct 2–6. — 2026-10-02 — https://tech-insider.org/oracle-health-breach-20-million-people-2026/
- EU antitrust regulators are making a preliminary inquiry into Oracle's licensing. The Commission says there is no formal investigation. The report predates the window. — 2026-09-01 — https://money.usnews.com/investing/news/articles/2026-09-01/oracle-licensing-practices-on-eu-antitrust-regulators-radar-source-says
- No fines or export-control actions found.

ORCL closed down 5.48% at $135.69. — 2026-10-08 — https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/08/open-ai-revenue-nvidia-oracle-coreweave.html and https://admiralmarkets.com/analytics/traders-blog/openai-revenue-ai-selloff-october-2026

writeup.headline: Oracle rates Hold: fast AI-driven growth offset by heavy cash burn, a weak balance sheet and poor trend.
writeup.thesis: Oracle scores 47, a Hold, just 3 points above the Sell line. Growth is the clear strength (score 86), with latest-quarter revenue growth of 29.6% year on year, TTM revenue growth of 21.6%, and growth sped up by 9.0 pp from the previous quarter. Against that, the massive capex build-out leaves an FCF margin of -60.3% excluding prepayments (reported -40.0%) and a cash-to-debt ratio of 0.3, so the balance sheet scores only 13 and quality 48. On valuation (38), absolute levels are not low, with P/S of 6.1x, EV/EBIT of 22.8x and an FCF yield 14.9 pp below the 10-year Treasury yield, though the stock is cheap against its own history (P/FCF not comparable), with EV/EBIT cheaper than at 55 of the last 61 month-ends. The trend score of 18 reflects a price 48.5% below its 52-week high and shares down 50.6% from 12 months ago to 1 month ago, while news is modestly positive (60) thanks to reaffirmed FY27 guidance and FY30 targets.
key_risks: Deeply negative free cash flow, which management guides to turn positive only in the second half of FY28
Weak balance sheet, with cash covering only 0.3x debt while spending stays heavy
Customer concentration: OpenAI is estimated at roughly half of the $664B RPO, and reports of lower OpenAI revenue have hit the stock
Weak price trend: shares 20.2 pp behind SPY over the last 126 trading days and 8.3% below the 200-day average
Litigation and regulatory issues, including a layoff-timing lawsuit and a reported Oracle Health breach
what_would_change: A drop of just 3 points, such as further price weakness or a news setback on OpenAI, would push the rating to Sell
Moving up 18 points to Buy would likely need free cash flow to improve materially, lifting quality, balance sheet and valuation scores
A sustained price recovery above the 200-day average would raise the trend score of 18
Missing FY27 guidance of at least $90B revenue or a slowdown in growth would erode the growth score that props up the rating
